title: Garlic Confit
description: Slow-baked garlic cloves mellowed in olive oil.
instructions:
Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 275 degrees. Sprinkle 1¼ cups peeled garlic cloves, root ends trimmed, with 1 teaspoon table salt in 8-inch square baking dish. Add 1½ cups extra-virgin olive oil and bake until garlic is golden brown and soft, 1 hour 5 minutes to 1¼ hours.

Remove baking dish from oven and let garlic cool in oil to room temperature, about 1 hour (garlic will darken slightly as it cools). Using slotted spoon, transfer garlic to airtight container. Strain oil through fine-mesh strainer into second airtight container. (Cooled garlic and oil can be refrigerated separately for up to 1 week or frozen for up to 6 months.)

ingredients.raw: 50 garlic cloves , peeled (1¼ cups), root ends trimmed
